A twisting stone signal-spire of mirrors, flags, and courier-birds, its beacon flickering thinner than it should. The Goldspire Relay twists upward like maintenance became monument, its weak fire making future failure visible. Wind, beacon-light, signal-workers, ridge paths, anxious maintenance, and a view wide enough to imply the rest of the story. The world feels like it is answering back from up here. The place breaks into usable table spaces: Signal yard: Mirrors, flags, and courier birds make communication visible. Beacon chamber: The light source flickers with meaning. Ridge overlook: The view connects every prior place at once. Maintenance stair: Narrow steps and tool niches make the spire feel worked, not decorative. Plants and materials: wind-bent ridge grass, lichen on signal stones, small herbs in stair cracks. Animals and background life: courier birds, ridge insects, tiny cliff goats that ignore danger.
